page_note: Page is 97.2% damaged — most segments are heavily lacunose. Two distinct teaching registers visible: (1) segments 4-23 develop a hortatory medical analogy — the wise/sage is likened to a physician who applies "cool medicine" through humble speech when rebuking a brother, with explicit ethical instruction about how to admonish (avoiding "strictness-of-truth," "foolishness," "hatred," using rebuke that brings to repentance). This is application layer. (2) Segments 24-31 shift to cosmological substrate: the powers of heaven (ⲛⲃⲁⲙ ⲛⲧ̄ⲡⲉ) reveal themselves in two faces (ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲱⲡⲟⲛ ⲥⲛⲉⲩ) — the face of agape/beauty/longing and the face of fear/love-of-strife — a binary cosmic mapping that stays internal to the system. (3) Segments 33-35 pivot to direct second-person address ("Thou thyself also... stand fast in these two faces"), applying the cosmic two-faces teaching to the audience. Classic frame: cosmic teaching → application of teaching to disciple.
